question.problem:
Consider the vectors

$$
{a}_{1}=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 2 \\ -1\end{aligned}],\,{a}_{2}=[\begin{aligned}-5 \\ -8 \\ 5\end{aligned}],\,{a}_{3}=[\begin{aligned}-1 \\ 2 \\ 1\end{aligned}],\,b=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 9 \\ 1\end{aligned}].
$$

If ${x}_{1}{a}_{1}+{x}_{2}{a}_{2}+{x}_{3}{a}_{3}=b,$ then what is ${x}_{1}+{x}_{2}+{x}_{3}?$
question.worked_solution:
If ${x}_{1}{a}_{1}+{x}_{2}{a}_{2}+{x}_{3}{a}_{3}=b$, then we have

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 2 \\ -1\end{aligned}]+{x}_{2}[\begin{aligned}-5 \\ -8 \\ 5\end{aligned}]+{x}_{3}[\begin{aligned}-1 \\ 2 \\ 1\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 9 \\ 1\end{aligned}] \\ [\begin{aligned}{x}_{1} \\ 2{x}_{1} \\ -{x}_{1}\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}-5{x}_{2} \\ -8{x}_{2} \\ 5{x}_{2}\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}-{x}_{3} \\ 2{x}_{3} \\ {x}_{3}\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 9 \\ 1\end{aligned}] \\ [\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}-5{x}_{2}-{x}_{3} \\ 2{x}_{1}-8{x}_{2}+2{x}_{3} \\ -{x}_{1}+5{x}_{2}+{x}_{3}\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 9 \\ 1\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

Equating the corresponding components, we get the following system:

$$
\{\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}-5{x}_{2}-{x}_{3}=1 \\ 2{x}_{1}-8{x}_{2}+2{x}_{3}=9 \\ -{x}_{1}+5{x}_{2}+{x}_{3}=1\end{aligned}
$$

We will solve this system using Gaussian elimination. First, we write the augmented matrix for this system:

$$
M=[\begin{aligned}1 & -5 & -1 & 1 \\ 2 & -8 & 2 & 9 \\ -1 & 5 & 1 & 1\end{aligned}].
$$

Row-reducing the augmented matrix, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}M & =[\begin{aligned}1 & -5 & -1 & 1 \\ 2 & -8 & 2 & 9 \\ -1 & 5 & 1 & 1\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & :={R}_{2}+(-2){R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & -5 & -1 & 1 \\ 0 & 2 & 4 & 7 \\ -1 & 5 & 1 & 1\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & -5 & -1 & 1 \\ 0 & 2 & 4 & 7 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 2\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

The system is now 

$$
\{\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}-5{x}_{2}-{x}_{3}=1 \\ 2{x}_{2}+4{x}_{3}=7 \\ 0=2.\end{aligned}
$$

However, the final equation $0=2$  gives a false statement. So the system has no solution.
